title: every code a /v1/fleet/engines/* refusal or finding carries: its HTTP status, the sentence and the fix, {name} a fact the answer names (proxy/enginecodes.py; the health page reads the same)

bad_request.fix: Send the fields the page asks for.

not_found.message: There is no such engine host or pairing here.

too_many.message: Too many pairing tries from this TandemApp.
too_many.fix: Wait a minute and try again.

lan_denied.message: This TandemApp may not use the local network, so it found no engine.
lan_denied.fix: Allow it under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Local Network, or type the engine's address.

lan_failed.message: The search on the local network failed: {detail}
lan_failed.fix: Type the engine's address instead, a tailnet name or address included.

unreachable.message: TandemApp cannot reach the engine at {address}:{port}.
unreachable.fix: Check that the engine host is on, that the engine runs (`bin/tandem start` there), and that the address and port are right.

not_an_engine.message: {address}:{port} answers, but not as a TandemLLM engine.
not_an_engine.fix: Check the address and port: the engine's port is 8000 unless its install chose another.

not_allowed.message: The engine at {address}:{port} refuses this machine's address.
not_allowed.fix: Add this machine's address to QSE_ALLOW_FROM on the engine host, or clear that setting.

pairing_unsupported.message: The engine at {address}:{port} is too old to pair by code.
pairing_unsupported.fix: Update the engine on its host, or connect with a password or a key under Other ways.

no_window.message: No pairing code is showing on the engine host.
no_window.fix: Run `tandem pair` on the engine host and type the code it prints.

code_spent.message: This code cannot be used any more: it expired, was used, or had five wrong tries.
code_spent.fix: Run `tandem pair` on the engine host again for a new code.

bad_code.fix: Type the 6 digits `tandem pair` printed on the engine host.

wrong_code.message: The code does not match: {tries_left} tries left.
wrong_code.fix: Type the code the engine host shows; after five wrong tries run `tandem pair` there again.

host_key_mismatch.message: The engine's SSH host key is {offered}, not the {expected} shown for it.
host_key_mismatch.fix: Compare it with the fingerprint `tandem pair` printed on the engine host: if they differ, something on the network changed the answer; do not pair.

rate_limited.message: The engine host takes no more pairing tries from here for now.
rate_limited.fix: Wait {retry_after} seconds, then type the code again.

key_present.message: TandemApp's key is already in the engine host's authorized_keys with another line.
key_present.fix: Remove that line on the engine host, then pair again.

key_refused.message: The engine host could not add TandemApp's key: {detail}
key_refused.fix: Fix ~/.ssh on the engine host as the message says (the user's own, not a link, not writable by others), then pair again.

engine_failed.message: The engine host could not finish: {detail}
engine_failed.fix: Try again; if it fails again, run `tandem doctor` on the engine host.

ssh_unreachable.message: TandemApp cannot reach SSH on {host} port {port}.
ssh_unreachable.fix: Check that the SSH server runs on the engine host and that port {port} is open from this machine, then retry.

host_key_changed.message: The engine host's SSH host key changed: it is {offered} now, {pinned} before.
host_key_changed.fix: If the engine host was reinstalled, pair it again by code (`tandem pair`), which proves the new key; otherwise do not connect.

host_key_unconfirmed.message: The SSH host key {offered} was not confirmed.
host_key_unconfirmed.fix: Compare it with the engine host's own (`ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` there) and send it back to confirm.

auth_failed.message: The engine host did not accept that user name and password.
auth_failed.fix: Check the user name and password for {host} and try again.

ssh_failed.fix: Check the address, port and user, then retry.

key_not_installed.message: The engine host does not take TandemApp's key yet.
key_not_installed.fix: Add the line shown to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of {user} on {host}, then check again.

not_paired.message: The engine host no longer takes TandemApp's key.
not_paired.fix: Pair it again by code (`tandem pair` on the engine host).

not_installed.message: No TandemLLM engine is installed at {dir} on {host}.
not_installed.fix: Install the engine there first, or give the folder it is installed in.

bad_engine_dir.message: The engine's folder on {host} has characters a key line cannot hold.
bad_engine_dir.fix: Install the engine in a folder whose path has only letters, digits and . _ / + @ -.

engine_too_old.message: The engine on {host} is too old for TandemApp's control.
engine_too_old.fix: Upgrade the engine on its host.

ctl_failed.message: The engine host's control command failed: {detail}
ctl_failed.fix: Run `tandem doctor` on the engine host.

http_blocked.message: TandemApp reaches the engine host over SSH but not the engine's port {port}.
http_blocked.fix: Open port {port} on the engine host's firewall for this machine; test it through SSH.

token_missing.message: TandemApp holds no HTTP token for this engine.
token_missing.fix: Rotate the token; TandemApp does it over SSH.

token_refused.message: The engine refused TandemApp's HTTP token.
token_refused.fix: Rotate the token; TandemApp does it over SSH.

setup_locked.message: The engine's Setup Guide wants its admin password.
setup_locked.fix: Remove the engine's admin password or use its own Setup page; TandemApp's token does not open the Setup Guide.

busy.fix: Wait until the running job or requests end, then try again.

setup_refused.fix: Change the choice as the message says.

unknown_model.message: The engine does not offer the model {model}.
unknown_model.fix: Pick a model from the list.

not_ssh.message: {node} is not an engine host TandemApp reaches over SSH.
not_ssh.fix: Pair the engine host by code under Add engine.
